iti78:1.1: vuttañhetaṁ →  (sya-all, pts) | sutaṁ → I follow M. which alone has first the general remark without reference to time, after that the three pieces Atītampi . . ., Anāgatam-pi . . ., Etarahi pi . . . . All other MSS. omit the piece Atītam-pi, D. E. completely, but the other MSS. insert parts of it into the general remark: B. C. insert atīte pi before the first bhikkhave, and addhānaṁ after it; Pa. inserts after the first samenti: atitaṁ pi bhikkhave addhānaṁ (pts note)
iti78:2.1: dhātuso → dhātusova (sya-all) | Dhātuso → Dhātuso va, D. E. (pts note)
iti78:4.1: dhātuso-va → va om. M.; dhātuyo va, E.; dhātuso yāva, D. (pts note)
iti78:4.3: samessanti → samissanti (bj) | samessanti → samissanti, B. M. (pts note)
iti78:5.1: paccuppannaṁ → paccuppanaṁ (bj, cck) | sattehi saddhiṁ →  (sya-all) | saddhiṁ → om. D. E. P. Pa. (pts note)
iti78:5.3: samentīti → samenti, C. D. E. P. Pa. (pts note)
iti78:5.5: vuccati → Etam- only in M. (pts note)
iti78:6.1: vanatho → vanato, B. C. P. Pa. (pts note)

iti78:7.4: hīnavīriyaṁ → -vīriyaṁ, C. D. E. M.; -viriyaṁ, B. P. Pa. (pts note)
iti78:8.1: pavivittehi → vivittehi, B; pavicittehi, D. E. (pts note)
